Ukraine has long feared an attack on its major transportation bridges since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022.
Traffic was gridlocked in Kyiv on Friday after the one of the city's main bridges was closed and restrictions placed on others after another wave of Russian drone strikes.

ADVERTISEMENT
Reporters in the city saw long queues of stationary cars and buses on main roads in the Ukrainian capital as commuters sought alternative routes.
Traffic built up due to the complete closure to traffic in both directions on the Southern Bridge, one of eight connecting the east and west of Kyiv over the Dnipro River.
The Paton Bridge, further north, was open only one way, city mayor Vitali Klitschko said, but there were no reports that it had been hit.

Ulyanovsk’s Zavolzhsky District Court has sentenced Anastasia Chumakova, Astra’s founder and editor-in-chief, in absentia to seven years in prison.
Chumakova was charged with spreading “fake news” about the Russian army and violating “foreign agent” regulations.
The court also barred her from running websites and other online platforms for four and a half years and fined her 200,000 rubles.
According to Astra, witnesses in the case included neighbors of Chumakova’s relatives who did not know her and had never seen her.
The prosecutor had sought a nine-year prison sentence for Chumakova.

Skip to main content
Ukrainian drone attacks hit Volgograd and Samara, setting a refinery and a major oil tank farm on fire
October 2, 2026, 7:02 am
Source: Meduza
Ukrainian drones struck Volgograd and Samara overnight on October 2. Andrey Bocharov, governor of the Volgograd region, said there had been a “massive drone attack on industrial infrastructure” but did not specify which facilities had been targeted. He said a residential building caught fire and one person was injured.
Photos and videos posted by eyewitnesses showed a large fire in the area of the Volgograd oil refinery and the Kaustik chemical plant, Astra reported . Ukrainian drones have attacked the refinery several times before. Astra also reported that city residents said no drone alert had been issued in Volgograd.
An oil pipeline operations and dispatch facility in Samara caught fire, according to Astra. The Samara station is Europe’s largest oil storage tank complex and part of Transneft’s network. Four pipelines carry oil to it from Western Siberia, Tatarstan, the Orenburg region, and Kazakhstan.

Figure caption, Watch: Why are students staging protests at schools in France?
By Malu Cursino
Published
1 October 2026
Fires have broken out at several schools in France, as students protest by blockading education institutions nationwide over school funding and studying conditions.
Blazes were reported at two high schools in Nantes, western France, while another was filmed engulfing the entrance of a school in the northern city of Rouen.
Students are protesting about a lack of teachers and staff, overcrowded classrooms and run-down buildings. University students joined the demonstrations on Thursday, citing similar demands.
The interior ministry said 1,949 people had been arrested on Thursday, with 305 police officers injured. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu held a crisis meeting on Thursday to discuss the unrest.
The government said afterwards that the student-led demonstrations had descended into "urban violence".

A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter entered Polish airspace on September 23 at 11:08 a.m., the operational command of the Polish army said.
The helicopter, flying from the Kaliningrad region, crossed about 300 meters (984 feet) into Polish airspace and remained there for 42 seconds, the Polish military said.
Poland scrambled fighter jets and put ground forces and equipment on alert. “The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense,” the command said.
Russia has not yet commented on the incident.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on September 17 that Russia is planning “hybrid” strikes using missiles and drones against countries that support Ukraine. Skip to main content

BERLIN — If the explosive had actually detonated, investigators might not have gotten their clearest look yet at what European officials believe is a wider Russian campaign of attacks.
On Aug. 4, a drone struck the wing of a Ukrainian aircraft at Germany’s Leipzig Airport and fell onto the tarmac. Strapped beneath it was a tin can packed with explosives. The device remained intact.
That gave investigators something unusually valuable: the bomb itself. The can was sealed with a metal plate stamped with seven circular indentations, according to an investigative file from German federal police reviewed by the Axel Springer Global Reporters Network.
Advertisement

A Ukrainian pilot has died after his MiG-29 fighter jet was shot down by a Russian missile whilst performing a combat mission in eastern Ukraine, the country's Air Force said on Oct. 1.
The pilot, Captain Marat Redvanovych Mambetov, ejected but did not survive, the Air Force said in a statement on social media.
Mambetov, who was 25 years old, served as a flight commander in the "Ghost of Kyiv" 40th Tactical Aviation Brigade.
The brigade, based at Vasylkiv Air Base in Kyiv Oblast, flies part of Ukraine's ageing fleet of Soviet-era Mikoyan MiG-29 fighter jets.
"We express our sincere condolences to Marat’s family and friends, he defended Ukraine until his last breath," the Air Force said.

UK-Iran national arrested under Terrorism Act over RAF Fairford incident
Counter-terrorism police arrest 27-year-old in Westminster, while second man questioned under caution
Detectives have arrested a dual UK-Iranian national on suspicion of terrorism offences as part of an investigation into a suspected plot near RAF Fairford.
Counter-terrorism police said the 27-year-old man was arrested on Thursday in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts under section 5 of the Terrorism Act 2006.
A second man, 26, who is a UK national, has been questioned under caution.
Five men in their 20s were arrested in the village of Whelford, Gloucestershire, outside the RAF base in the early hours of Sunday after police were alerted to suspicious vans in the area. They were released on police bail.

Článek
Nový „nouzový bezpečnostní mechanismus“ má umožnit rychlou koordinaci ve chvíli, kdy některá členská země zaznamená hybridní útok. Zástupci zemí se sešli v pondělí, aby zkoordinovali svou reakci. Podle Kallasové jde o situace, které sice nedosahují úrovně ozbrojeného útoku, přesto ale vyžadují společnou evropskou reakci.
„Musíme být ostražití, protože ze zpravodajských informací vyplývá, že Rusko plánuje další sabotážní akce,“ uvedla podle serveru Euronews .
Ačkoli diplomaté uvádějí, že podrobnosti o tom, co by…

Při útoku byla zraněna také 44letá učitelka, která je ve stabilizovaném stavu.
Útočníka ze slovenské základky vychovávali prarodiče, matka byla v těžké životní situaci

BRUSSELS — Five European countries agreed at an emergency meeting Thursday to respond with "one voice" to growing pressure from the U.S. government to release reserves of diesel, according to people familiar with the matter.
France, Germany, Britain, Italy, Ireland and the European Commission joined the talks to decide how to respond to pressure from Washington to draw down oil stockpiles or face a ban on U.S. exports of diesel, three European officials told POLITICO.
All these countries have been privately pressured by the U.S. to draw down on their reserves, two of the people said.

Rus v Tbilisi močil z balkonu na ulici a vzýval Rusko. Video: Teona Gholodze/TikTok
Článek
Rus jménem Alexandr Popov v pondělí pod vlivem alkoholu močil z balkonu svého bytu v Tbilisi na návštěvníky kavárny. Když ho však místní konfrontovali, své počínání omlouval tím, že toaleta v jeho bytě zrovna byla obsazená. Navíc se hájil argumentem, že kavárna v přízemí domu je zřízená bez povolení úřadů.
Záběry z incidentu, které zveřejnila na TikToku místní obyvatelka Teona Gholodzeová, zřejmě zachycují situaci po močení, kdy je slyšet, jak muž z balkonu dvakrát zvolá „Sláva Rusku“. Frázi pronesl poprvé, když se ho zezdola zeptala, proč močí z balkonu, a podruhé ji zopakoval poté, co…

titulek: Russian jet-powered drone exploded in Moldova
titulekPuvodni: Russian jet-powered drone exploded in Moldova
shrnuti: A jet-powered Russian drone crashed near a Moldovan highway, leaving thermal damage and fragments across a 120-meter radius in Orhei district.

vyrez.text:
Moldova confirms jet-powered Russian drone blast in Orhei | Ukrainska Pravda
Drone debris. Photo: Moldovan authorities' Facebook
A drone, believed to be a jet-powered Geran model, exploded in the Orhei district in Moldova on the evening of 30 September.
Source: European Pravda , citing the Moldovan Ministry of Defence and the General Police Inspectorate, quoted by Moldovan media outlet Newsmaker
Details: According to Moldovan authorities, the drone entered the country's airspace at around 20:45. It then crashed after colliding with trees near the village of Branesti in the Orhei district.
Advertisement:





Police received a report of a loud sound resembling an explosion.
Shortly before midnight, police, based on early reports, stated that the discovered drone had characteristics typical of a jet-powered Geran.
On 1 October, law enforcement officers clarified the circumstances of the crash: according to their data, the explosion occurred after the drone collided with trees in a tree line right next to a highway.






A crater approximately 50 cm in diameter and about 30 cm deep formed at the site. Damaged trees, traces of a shockwave and thermal impact were discovered…

On Latvian Public Media (LSM), content in Russian will only be permitted in exceptional circumstances, in the event of a state of emergency, or for the specific purpose of countering disinformation. This was decided by the Saeima on Thursday, 1 October.
55 MPs voted ‘for’, whilst 24 voted ‘against’.
Latvian Television and Latvian Radio do not broadcast in Russian, but the LSM.lv portal still produces content in Russian.
Until now, public media had been obliged to produce programmes in minority languages, but following the Constitutional Court’s (ST) judgement, this situation had to change, as the court ruled that LSM’s content must primarily be in Latvian, whilst the Russian language is self-sufficient in the Latvian media, and therefore the state need not take special care of it. Evropské alianční země v posledních měsících opakovaně upozorňují na nárůst ruských hybridních aktivit, mezi něž řadí sabotáže, žhářství, kybernetické útoky, narušování kritické infrastruktury či vzdušného prostoru a dezinformační kampaně. Podle evropských představitelů mají tyto aktivity mimo jiné oslabovat podporu Ukrajiny a narušovat jednotu evropských zemí.

V Praze se ve středu konala čtrnáctá mezinárodní konference k poctě laureáta Ceny Václava Havla za lidská práva. Laureátkou za rok 2026 je íránská právnička Nasrín Sotudíová. Ta zastupovala aktivisty, novináře, příslušníky menšin i děti ohrožené trestem smrti a zároveň se zasazovala o zrušení povinného nošení hidžábu či trestu smrti. Sotudíová byla opakovaně zatčena a strávila roky ve vězení. Konference, jejímž tématem je Váha slova, nabídla právě příběhy laureátů, kteří byli vězněni, stejně jako příspěvky fundovaných odborníků. Vedle Sotudíové se akce zúčastnili například ruský učitel a autor dokumentu Pan Nikdo proti Putinovi Pavel Talankin nebo běloruská opoziční politička Maryja Kalesnikavová.

Při ruském raketovém a dronovém útoku na Kyjevskou oblast zahynulo dítě a další dva lidé, oznámili tamní představitelé. Polsko kvůli těmto útokům vyslalo do vzduchu své vojenské letouny, v pohotovosti je také protivzdušná obrana, sdělila polská armáda. Poláci rovněž dočasně uzavřeli dvě letiště, jejichž provoz je již obnoven.

The two people were killed in their homes in a low-density residential area, Sumy Oblast governor Oleh Hryhorov reported on social media.

Et kraftigt lavtryk over Nordatlanten skaber tirsdag en markant kontrast i vejret over det nordvestlige Europa.
I Irland er der udsendt varsler om både kraftig vind og regn, og langs dele af kysten er der risiko for oversvømmelser. 
Den irske vejrtjeneste, Met Éireann, har tirsdag udsendt gule varsler om kraftig vind og regn. Langs kysterne advares der blandt andet om høje bølger og lokale oversvømmelser. (© Met Éireann)

Článek
Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) se dnes po uložení korunovačních klenotů setkal s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem. Babiš to v úterý řekl serveru Deník.cz . Hovořili podle něj o programu příští Bezpečnostní rady státu, včetně možné reakce na případný ruský útok na některý z pobaltských států. Setkání následně ČTK potvrdil i prezidentův mluvčí Vojtěch Šeliga, tématem podle něj bylo příští zasedání rady a aktuální bezpečnostní otázky. Příští Bezpečnostní rada státu bude 20. října, Babiš minulý týden uvedl, že po jejím jednání chce představit projekt související s tajnými službami.

Estland wirft Russland Sabotage vor: Hinter einem Brandanschlag auf eine Rüstungsfirma in Tallinn steckt nach neuesten Erkenntnissen Russland. NATO-Chef Rutte rief die Bündnismitglieder auf, ruhig zu bleiben.

Die Behörden leiteten Ermittlungen ein, die nun zu dem Schluss kommen: Russland steckt dahinter. Dies teilte Regierungschef Kristen Michal unter Berufung auf Ermittlungsergebnisse der Sicherheitsbehörden mit. Russian airlines recorded a 7% drop in passenger traffic during the summer travel season, as a surge of daily Ukrainian drone attacks disrupted operations at dozens of airports across the country, the Interfax news agency reported Tuesday.
Dmitry Yadrov, who heads the civilian aviation agency Rosaviatsia, said in a meeting with Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin that Russian airlines transported 39.5 million passengers between May and August.
That is reportedly down from around 42.6 million passengers who were transported over the same period last year.
The drop comes amid near-daily disruptions at Russian airports due to Ukrainian attacks.

Článek
Všech pět podezřelých, kteří byli v neděli zadrženi u západoanglické základny RAF Fairford využívané americkým letectvem, jsou britští občané žijící v Londýně. Britské úřady v pondělí nadále zadržovaly pětici zatčených mužů a zkoumaly podezřelé výbušniny nalezené poblíž letecké základny provozované USA, zatímco protiterorističtí vyšetřovatelé zjišťovali, zda se díky těmto zatčením podařilo zmařit útok napojený na Írán, píše agentura AP.
U základny, odkud vzlétaly americké…

„Do neobytné budovy v Ševčenkovské čtvrti, v centru města, narazil dron. Vypukl požár,“ oznámil na platformě Telegram Kličko, přičemž videa z místa útoku jasně ukazují, že se jedná o budovu Národní akademie věd.

„Obyvatele bych rád požádal, aby k místu nechodili a záchranným službám neztěžovali práci,“ uvedl Sazanovyč.
Na videích hořící budovy jsou vidět lidé stojící na římsách, zatímco se kolem nich z oken valí černý kouř. Z jiného úhlu je zase vidět, že se budově zřítila střecha…
